reported.title: Missing debounce handling
reported.description: The sketch does not properly debounce the button press, allowing for potential multiple toggles due to switch bounce, which can last up to 20 ms.

reported.title: Incorrect lamp toggle timing
reported.description: The toggleLamp function is called immediately upon detecting a state change, which may not respect the 150 ms requirement for toggling after a press.

judge_input.spec:
- Lobby switch on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW); accent lamp on D12.
- Each settled press toggles the lamp exactly once within 150 ms; release must not toggle.
- Bounce up to 20 ms must not create extra toggles.
- Settle window is 45 ms before accepting a press.
- Print `lobby lamp=ON n=<count>` or `lobby lamp=OFF n=<count>` every 1400 ms.
- Idle switch level is HIGH.
